newsitem.title: USA: Nextel shares jump on analysts' upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Nextel shares jump on analysts' upgrades.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc shares shot upward to a new record level on Monday after a Morgan Stanley analyst initiated the stock with a strong buy rating, analysts said.
Nextel shares gaine 2-13/16 to close at 26-11/16 and was the second most active issue of the day on Nasdaq with volume of 9.6 million shares. The stock's previous year-high was 25.

In initiating coverage, Morgan Stanley's Colette Fleming set a $30 target 12-month target price on Nextel. She praised the company's differentiated product line, strong management, financial backing and improvements made to its technology.
The stock's move following an extensive report issued last Wednesday by Bear Stearns analyst David Freedman, who raised the stock to attractive from neutral, the analyst said.

Last Tuesday, Craig McCaw and other members of the McCaw family had announced they would invest an additional $232.5 million in the company, increasing the McCaw stake in the company to a value of roughly $600 million.

Nextel is aggressively building mobile communications networks targetted at business customers in the United States and overseas. Analysts project substantial earnings losses in upcoming years as the company constructs these networks.
